## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? Two or three sentences is usually enough. -->

## Related task ID

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` - new functionality
- [ ] `fix` - bug fix
- [ ] `chore` - tooling, config, or repo housekeeping
- [ ] `docs` - documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `test` - no behaviour change

## Definition of Done (PRD 12.3)

- [ ] Merged through a pull request with at least 1 approval
- [ ] CI is green
- [ ] If setup steps changed, a teammate reproduced the setup from the README alone
- [ ] README and `/docs` updated if setup steps changed
- [ ] No secrets in the diff: no connection strings, API keys, tokens, or `.env` contents
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
